name.value: Canadian Country Music Hall of Fame

description.value: The Canadian Country Music Hall of Fame is a museum and landmark in Merritt, BC — a town that bills itself as the Country Music Capital of Canada. It honours inductees from across the Canadian country music industry, including both performing artists and behind-the-scenes builders. A touring cyclist passing through Merritt's compact downtown would find it a short detour off the main corridor.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible museum and local landmark in Merritt's downtown — a legitimate stop for touring cyclists passing through the area.

wow_evidence: National hall of fame in the self-styled Country Music Capital of Canada; modest museum visit unless you're a country fan.
